claim: All 20 daily layouts have exactly one solution.
sandbox: deterministic solver; enumerate all row and column permutations for every authored puzzle; assert one valid layout each

claim: One shared puzzle is selected for each UTC date.
sandbox: deterministic core; select the puzzle twice for the same fixed date; assert equal puzzle data and a valid id

claim: The fixed sample shows the complete game and reaches a solved result.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; place the shipped sample solution; assert the solved result and score

claim: The sample opens at ?demo=1 and saves progress and sound separately from daily play.
where: landing action, demo banner, README, and demo guide
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed daily progress and sound, open /?demo=1, assert demo starts with its own sound setting, change it, then reset and exit while asserting only demo progress and sound keys are removed

claim: Restart sample clears the sample layout.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; solve the sample; restart; assert all grid cells are empty

claim: A hint reveals one exact position and costs one score leaf.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; reveal one hint; assert an exact position appears and score falls from four to three leaves

claim: Three incorrect checks open the solution explanation.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; submit the same incorrect complete layout three times; assert the explanation opens

claim: The sound setting stays in this browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; turn sound off; reload; assert the muted state remains

where: landing facts, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; place one specimen; reload; assert the same cell remains filled

claim: The puzzle works with keyboard controls.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; select with Enter; move across grid with arrows; place with Enter

claim: The game runs at 60 frames per second on the mid-range phone test profile.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at 390x844 with device scale factor 2 and 4x CPU throttling; measure three one-second requestAnimationFrame samples; assert the median is 55-65 fps

claim: The complete game is playable without payment.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; solve the shipped sample and assert the end screen appears with no payment, purchase, or subscription controls

claim: The site uses no analytics, ads, cookies, or third-party scripts.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; record requests through a full sample run, assert an empty document.cookie value, only same-origin requests, and no analytics, advertising, sign-in, chat, or submission controls/scripts

claim: The game sends no personal data and loads no third-party runtime resources.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; record requests while revealing a hint and placing a specimen; assert every request is same-origin

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service worker; set context offline; reload; assert the sample heading is visible
